I haven't set up the 17:30 post. I replied to June in the #strategic-pod thread to say so.

I only act when someone messages me. The cron tool here saves its output locally and can't post into Slack, so a scheduled note would never appear in the channel. I offered to post the "Pod end of day" note whenever someone asks, and suggested she set a recurring calendar reminder for 17:30.
